Q6111.reason: A general littering ordinance is a content-neutral O'Brien regulation that serves park cleanliness and only incidentally burdens symbolic speech.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove; the plaintiff's removal was unauthorized, and the defendant's timely remand motion requires return of the whole case.

Q5651.reason: Advertising the car as a 1964 creates an express warranty of description that an 'as is' clause cannot disclaim under UCC 2-316.
